steve-mann--swim-phenomenal-ar.why_en: A sweeping row of lights freezes a sound or radio wave in the air, exactly where the wave really is.
steve-mann--swim-phenomenal-ar.why_zh: 一排扫过空间的灯把声波或无线电波定格在空中，就在它真实所在的位置。

instituto-stocos--piano-and-dancer.why_en: A piano with no pianist plays itself in answer to a dancer who never touches it.
instituto-stocos--piano-and-dancer.why_zh: 一架没有钢琴师的钢琴自己弹奏，回应一位从不触碰它的舞者。

joon-moon--hello-shadow.why_en: Turn a light around a sculpture and its shadow on the wall becomes a shape the object could never cast.
joon-moon--hello-shadow.why_zh: 拿着灯绕着雕塑转，墙上的影子却变成物体本身不可能投出的形状。

kde-dance--empa.why_en: Two people swap eyes and dance hand in hand, each seeing through the other's view.
kde-dance--empa.why_zh: 两个人交换眼睛，手牵手跳舞，各自透过对方的视角看世界。

clemence-debaig--social-distancing-shirt.why_en: A shirt that says 'You are too close' until the person near you steps back.
clemence-debaig--social-distancing-shirt.why_zh: 一件会开口说“你靠得太近了”的衬衫，直到对方退后才停下。

phoenix-perry--bot-party.why_en: Players can only pass messages between their little bots by touching skin to skin, so the body becomes the network cable.
phoenix-perry--bot-party.why_zh: 玩家只有肌肤相触才能让小机器人互传消息，身体成了网线。

cyril-diagne--ar-cut-paste.why_en: Point a phone at a real object to cut it out, then point at your screen to paste it in.
cyril-diagne--ar-cut-paste.why_zh: 用手机对准真实物体把它“剪”下来，再对准电脑屏幕把它“贴”进去。

roelof-knol--connected.why_en: Lines of light on the floor join the strangers standing in the room, so each person's personal space becomes shared.
roelof-knol--connected.why_zh: 地面上的光线把房间里的陌生人连在一起，每个人的私人空间变成了共享空间。

cyril-diagne--enthusiast-overlay.why_en: Hanging tennis balls get scribbled cartoon faces and bodies and bounce around with endless enthusiasm.
cyril-diagne--enthusiast-overlay.why_zh: 悬挂的网球被画上潦草的卡通脸和身体，带着无尽的热情蹦来蹦去。

field-io--fort-builder.why_en: Stack digital copies of your own cushions and chairs into a fort, then let it crash down without breaking anything.
field-io--fort-builder.why_zh: 用自家靠垫和椅子的数字复制品搭一座堡垒，再让它轰然倒塌，什么都不会摔坏。
